name: MonarchTimeOffPanel
title: TimeOffPanel
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of Monarch rows, with androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet, androidx.compose.material3.DatePickerDialog, androidx.compose.material3.TimePickerDialog and androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
summary: Lists time off (holidays, sickness, training, closures) and adds or removes it, with an Include past switch, an add sheet and a danger confirmation.
whenToUse: On a team's or a person's scheduling settings, where periods nobody can be booked are kept: holidays, sickness, training and office closures.
whenNotToUse: For regular weekly working hours use a schedule of time ranges; for one-off bookings use the calendar components; to see who is away on which day use MonarchTeamCalendar.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchTimeOffPanel(entries: List<MonarchTimeOffEntry>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, onAdd: (suspend (MonarchTimeOffDraft) -> Unit)? = null, onRemove: (suspend (MonarchTimeOffEntry) -> Unit)? = null, canRemove: ((MonarchTimeOffEntry) -> Boolean)? = null, people: List<MonarchSelectOption<String>> = emptyList(), allowClosure: Boolean = false, types: List<MonarchSelectOption<String>> = emptyList(), showPast: Boolean? = null, onShowPastChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, loading: Boolean = false, error: String? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, timeZone: String? = null, now: Long? = null, is24Hour: Boolean? = null, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), addIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, notice: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchTimeOffPanelLabels = MonarchTimeOffPanelLabels())

data class MonarchTimeOffEntry(id: String, personId: String?, allDay: Boolean, start: Long, end: Long, personName: String? = null, type: String? = null, reason: String? = null, status: String? = null)
data class MonarchTimeOffDraft(personId: String?, allDay: Boolean, start: Long, end: Long, type: String? = null, reason: String? = null)

class MonarchTimeOffPanelLabels(title: String? = null, description: String? = null, add: String? = null, includePast: String? = null, closure: String? = null, everyone: String? = null, past: String? = null, allDay: String? = null, allDayLabel: String? = null, remove: String? = null, removeEntry: ((who: String, time: String) -> String)? = null, removeTitle: String? = null, removeDescription: String? = null, removeConfirm: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyDescription: String? = null, loading: String? = null, retry: String? = null, sheetDescription: ((zone: String) -> String)? = null, who: String? = null, type: String? = null, closureNotice: String? = null, from: String? = null, until: String? = null, start: String? = null, end: String? = null, reason: String? = null, reasonDescription: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, confirmPick: String? = null, endBeforeStart: String? = null, failed: String? = null)

options.name: entries
options.description: The periods, in display order. All-day entries are days as UTC midnights (end included); timed entries are instants.

options.name: onAdd
options.description: Shows Add time off; the sheet stays busy while it runs and shows the message of what it throws.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Shows each entry's remove button; called after the danger confirmation, which stays busy while it runs.

options.name: canRemove
options.description: Which entries may be removed; null allows all.

options.name: people
options.description: The people Who offers; Who is hidden when there is one choice.

options.name: allowClosure
options.description: Adds Everyone to Who, a closure for everyone (personId null).

options.name: types
options.description: The kinds Type offers; empty hides Type.

options.name: showPast / onShowPastChange
options.description: Whether past entries are listed (null: the panel keeps it, starting false), and the callback of Include past.

options.name: error / onRetry
options.description: A danger banner instead of the list, with Try again.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The zone timed entries are shown and entered in, and that decides today. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: now
options.description: The instant that decides which entries are past; pass a fixed value in tests.

options.name: is24Hour
options.description: A 24-hour clock; null follows the device setting.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the list.

options.name: addIcon / removeIcon
options.description: An icon in the add button; the glyph of the remove buttons (null shows them as text).

options.name: notice
options.description: Content above the list, for example a MonarchBanner.

states.name: list
states.description: One row per entry: who, badges (Closure, the type, the status, Past) and when, with a remove button.

states.name: past hidden
states.description: Entries that ended before now are left out until Include past is on.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three placeholders read as "Loading time off".

states.name: error
states.description: A danger banner with Try again.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState: "No time off planned".

states.name: adding
states.description: A bottom sheet with Who, Type, All day, the dates (and times), Reason and Add time off; the end before the start shows an error; the button shows its loading state while onAdd runs.

states.name: removing
states.description: An alert dialog naming the entry, with a danger Remove button that shows its loading state while onRemove runs.

appearance: A title in the default text color with a muted description, a switch row, rows with a strong name and muted dates, badges in the warning (Closure), neutral (type), info (status) and outline (Past) styles, and Material 3 sheets and dialogs in the Monarch theme. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web opens the add form in a centered dialog with inline date and date-time pickers; on Android it is a bottom sheet whose date and time buttons open the Material 3 DatePickerDialog and TimePickerDialog, the phone pattern. From and Until are two DatePickerDialogs (Until cannot be earlier than From) rather than one DateRangePicker, so all-day and timed entries share the same date field. The web's Include past checkbox is a switch row. Entries and drafts use epoch milliseconds (days as UTC midnights) instead of ISO strings, and the zone is a java.util.TimeZone as in other Monarch scheduling components, so the zone shown in the sheet is its id. onAdd and onRemove are suspend functions where the web returns a promise. The web moves focus to the next remove button after a removal; on Android TalkBack moves on by itself and focus is not moved. The web's headingLevel, locale and uncontrolled defaultShowPast are not offered (the locale comes from the configuration; showPast null keeps it inside). The panel is a LazyColumn, so it takes the screen's height and must not sit in a vertically scrolling parent. iOS has no entry yet.
accessibility: Each entry is one TalkBack element read as who, its badges and when; badges are words, so nothing depends on color.
Each remove button is named after the entry, "Remove time off for Alex Kim, Mon, Nov 9, 2026 – Fri, Nov 13, 2026 (all day)", and has a 48dp target.
Include past is a switch row with the switch role and its state.
Removing asks first in an alert dialog; it cannot be dismissed while the removal runs, and a failure is read through an assertive live region.
The add sheet's failure is an assertive banner; the end-before-start problem is shown as the error of the date fields.
Dates and names wrap at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: An all-day entry that ends today is not past; a timed entry is past once its end instant is.
Choosing a From day after Until moves Until to it; Until cannot be before From in its picker.
A timed end equal to its start is refused; an all-day entry may be one day.
A closure has no person: personId is null and it reads Everyone.
A thrown exception with a blank message shows "That did not work. Try again."

examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchTimeOffPanel(
    entries = emptyList(),
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    loading = !failed,
    error = if (failed) "Time off could not be loaded." else null,
    onRetry = { failed = false },
    now = 1_793_793_600_000L,
)
